conditions.title: real fee accrual / actual position tokenId data
conditions.background: 5 stages used heuristic 0.5%/day turnover, no actual position data. Heuristic 100x higher than observed 10/20u quote-derived 0.005%/day.
conditions.why_needed: Need on-chain historical position data to validate heuristic
how_to_provide: paid RPC + indexer (Helius, Triton, QuickNode) for history

conditions.title: protocol incentives / external rewards / bribes
conditions.background: 5 stages used pool.fee_rate only. Protocol LM + bribes + IFO not included.
conditions.why_needed: LP real yield = fee + LM + bribe. Only fee severely underestimates positive EV. Some protocols' LM is 5-10x fee.
how_to_provide: specific protocol LM contract (e.g. Meteora farm program)

conditions.title: stable high fee velocity pool
conditions.background: 5 stages best cells are memecoin / speculative pools. Memecoin unsuitable for 7d hold.
conditions.why_needed: Current heuristic 0.5%/day is average. Need >1%/day pools.

conditions.title: lower cost link
conditions.background: 5 stages fixed_cost = $0.003-0.006 per round-trip. retail 10 USD = 0.06% ratio. Must 10-100x reduce.
conditions.why_needed: Cost ratio directly kills retail LP. Must compress to $0.0001 level.
how_to_provide: precise cost breakdown (rent + priority fee + slippage + jito tip)

conditions.title: paid RPC / indexer
conditions.background: 5 stages used public RPC. 429 rate limit causes quote-ready count loss: Meteora 27/56 (48%), Orca 10/75 (13%), stable 10/25 (40%).
conditions.why_needed: Complete quote coverage requires paid RPC or indexer.
how_to_provide: paid RPC endpoint (Helius / Triton / QuickNode) with rate limit headroom
Birdeye / DexScreener API for pool metadata

conditions.title: user-specific pool / capital / strategy
conditions.background: 5 stages generic search, no user context.
conditions.why_needed: Retail generic doesn't work. Need user-specific assumptions.

conditions.title: non-standard LP structural strategy
conditions.background: 5 stages vanilla LP (hold → fee → IL). Pro LP use structural strategies.
conditions.why_needed: Vanilla LP doesn't work. Structural may 5-10x yield + reduce IL.

caveats: Reopen cost: 7 conditions + EV re-verify = 1-2 weeks work
Reopen ROI: even if 7 conditions met, retail 10/20U may still be negative EV; reopen != guaranteed positive EV
Manual decision required: reopen is operator decision, not auto-trigger
Re-STOP if still negative: if 7 conditions met but EV still negative, must STOP again. No forced probe.
alternative_paths_if_cannot_meet_7: (b) switch to other research (event-driven trading, arbitrage, options)
(c) switch to scanner / monitoring tool (no trading)
